description: Score the Best Of Motivation Leadership Style Quiz once the user has answered all 15 questions from start_leadership_style_quiz. Pass the letters in question order. Returns the user's leadership style and a link to take the quiz on the site for the free personalised report. After scoring, reply only with the result lines the tool returns: no strengths, blind spots or advice of your own.

answers.description: The 15 letters the user chose, in question order, e.g. ["A","C",...]. Questions 1-14 use A-D; question 15 uses A-E.
